studies.title: Zhangjiajie
studies.caption: Sandstone pillars rise from forested ravines, their tops carrying small stands of trees.
studies.prompt: Oblique view from a forested ridge across many tall narrow quartz-sandstone pillars of Zhangjiajie, near-vertical fluted walls, small trees growing on flat uneven tops, cloud in deep ravines. No floating mountains, glass bridge, elevator or fantasy temples.
